paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in terms of Recall@50 and NDCG@50 as the depth of search increases from 1 to 5. The left y-axis represents Recall@50, with values ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, while the right y-axis shows NDCG@50, with values from 0.10 to 0.35. The x-axis, labeled with integers from 1 to 5, indicates the search depth. The green solid line with circular markers, labeled "Recall@50 (Ours)," starts at a Recall@50 of approximately 0.38 at depth 1 and steadily increases to about 0.58 at depth 5. The blue solid line with square markers, labeled "NDCG@50 (Ours)," begins at a value of approximately 0.22 at depth 1 and rises to around 0.27 at depth 5. The green dotted line, labeled "Recall@50 (ReFICR)," remains constant at a value of 0.35 across all search depths. The blue dotted line, labeled "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)," is also constant, staying at a value of 0.10 throughout the range of search depths. The plot includes a legend in the upper left corner to distinguish between the four lines.
